name: Click Assist
description: Makes tight windows easier with input buffering and coyote time. This is an assist mod, do not use it for leaderboard records.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the click assist on or off.

debug.name: Debug Notifications
debug.description: Show a notification every time the assist activates.

buffer-ms.name: Input Buffer (ms)
buffer-ms.description: A click made in the air is remembered for this long and jumps automatically when you land.

coyote-ms.name: Coyote Time (ms)
coyote-ms.description: You can still jump for a short moment after leaving the ground or the edge of a block.
